title: 矽中介層佈線
summary: 以 12 個技術單元、24 步分析與驗證深入矽中介層布線、TSV 與回流路徑。逐一建立剖面、測試見證、失效判別和可審查的驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units and 24 analysis/verification steps explore silicon interposer routing, tsvs and return paths, building sections, test witnesses, failure discrimination and reviewable acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開工程原理與原創教學推理；數值是明示假設的算例，不是生產配方或供應商規格。各單元先建立物理模型，再設計能區分失效機制的量測。24 步是學習工作包，完整量產需經授權設備、材料及產品資格驗證。
scopeEn: Public engineering principles and original educational reasoning. Numbers are explicitly hypothetical examples, not production recipes or supplier specifications. Each unit builds a physical model then measurements that discriminate failure mechanisms. The 24 steps are learning work packages; production requires qualified equipment, materials and product validation.

stages.title: 接口與架構
stages.description: 針對接口與架構完成三個專屬技術單元；每個單元包含物理分析與量測診斷兩步。
stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for interfaces and architecture, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

steps.title: 被動與主動中介層｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Passive and active interposers | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對被動與主動中介層，把「是否含主動電路改變供電、測試和熱需求。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For passive and active interposers, turn "Active circuitry changes power, testing and thermal requirements." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「被動與主動中介層」的模型：是否含主動電路改變供電、測試和熱需求。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「標出被動線路及主動功能邊界。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for passive and active interposers: Active circuitry changes power, testing and thermal requirements. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Mark passive wiring and active functions. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 標出被動線路及主動功能邊界。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Mark passive wiring and active functions. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：所有矽中介層都只是無源連線。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。

steps.check: 交付被動與主動中介層的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for passive and active interposers, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

steps.instruction: 以先前模型進行證據審查：檢查模型版本及重複計算界面。 將「各自模擬合格可直接視為整機合格」當作待否定假說，另提出一項可能造成相同表象的混淆因素。安排對照樣本、座標和重複量測，分開記錄觀察值與機制推論；指出哪個結果會讓你暫停放行。
steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Check versions and double-counted interfaces. Challenge the hypothesis "Treating separate simulations as system qualification" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 檢查模型版本及重複計算界面。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Check versions and double-counted interfaces. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：各自模擬合格可直接視為整機合格。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Treating separate simulations as system qualification. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付共同簽核的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for co-signoff: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

knowledge.title: 共同簽核：機制
knowledge.text: 中介層、晶粒及封裝模型需相同端口與參考面。
knowledge.textEn: Interposer, die and package models need consistent ports/reference planes.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 檢查模型版本及重複計算界面。 必須排除的錯判：各自模擬合格可直接視為整機合格。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Check versions and double-counted interfaces. Misinterpretation to reject: Treating separate simulations as system qualification. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

quiz.question: 在「共同簽核」的證據與診斷中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For co-signoff — evidence and diagnosis — which decision or action is justified?
options: 各自模擬合格可直接視為整機合格
差分訊號完全不需地參考
檢查模型版本及重複計算界面。
optionsEn: Treating separate simulations as system qualification
Assuming differential signals need no ground reference
Check versions and double-counted interfaces.
quiz.explanation: 中介層、晶粒及封裝模型需相同端口與參考面。 檢查模型版本及重複計算界面。 因此不能採用「各自模擬合格可直接視為整機合格」。
quiz.explanationEn: Interposer, die and package models need consistent ports/reference planes. Check versions and double-counted interfaces. Therefore reject: Treating separate simulations as system qualification.
